title: Algal RNA Extraction Protocol Using Ambion TRI Reagent
author: Robert Auber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bv3hn8j6
materials: Using the Eppendorf ThermoMixer, incubate at 4 °C for 00:30:00 .

Wipe down with RNAse away: Chemical fume hood. Remove the spill pad from the chemical fume hood if present and replace with a new pad. RNA clean work station Rotors on large microcentrifuge and bench top spinner ThermoMixer Plastic racks (in RNA clean drawer) Pipettes (in RNA clean drawer)
Get liquid nitrogen if starting from live cells.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace and prepare necessary materials for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Set a large bench top centrifuge (with 50 mL falcon tube compatibility) and a ThermoMixer to 4 °C.
Prepare 75% ethanol by mixing 1.5 mL ethanol with 500 µL nuclease free water per sample; scale up as needed.

Using gloved hands sprayed with RNAse away, obtain three 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes per sample from the RNA clean drawer, cap them tightly, and label each vertically on the side with a unique identifier (starting with a letter, max 12 characters).
Place one set of 1 mL pipettes and tips, and one set of 50 mL and 1.5 mL tube racks inside the chemical fume hood.
Place two labeled 1.5 mL tubes per sample inside the chemical fume hood and leave the third tube at the RNA clean workstation.

steps.title: Collect and Freeze Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the algal cells and prepare the pellet for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Collect approximately 10 million cells growing exponentially in a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 4000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Pour off the supernatant into a P. pavum waste container.
Flash freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Initial Lysis with TRI Reagent
steps.instruction: Lysis the frozen cells using TRI Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Immediately add TRI Reagent to the frozen pellet (or store in -80 °C freezer).
Warm the frozen centrifuge tube by cupping the area around the pellet in the palm of your hand.
As soon as the edges of the pellet begin to melt, add 1 mL TRI Reagent.
Pipet up and down to dislodge the pellet and transfer the mixture to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Incubate at room temperature for an additional 00:15:00.

steps.title: Remove Debris (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform an optional centrifugation if high amounts of debris are present.

substeps.instruction: If significant debris is noticed following incubation, centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from DNA and proteins using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform to the tube.
Secure the cap and mix well by vigorously shaking the tube for 00:00:15.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes.
Carefully transfer approximately 500 µL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to a fresh 1.5 mL tube, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of isopropanol and vortex for 00:00:10 until the solution turns cloudy.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C, for 8 minutes, orienting the tube so the cap hinge is on the outer edge of the rotor.
Discard the supernatant by first using a 1 mL pipette tip for the bulk volume and then a 200 µL pipette tip for the remaining liquid, avoiding the hinge side of the tube.

steps.title: RNA Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet to remove residual salts.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol to wash the pellet (do not vortex or disrupt the pellet).
Centrifuge at 7500 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes, orienting the tube hinge on the outside of the rotor.
Discard the supernatant using a 1 mL pipette tip for the initial volume.
Briefly spin down the tube using a bench top spinner.
Use a 200 µL pipet tip to remove the last bit of liquid, tipping the tube slightly and pipetting from the bottom corner opposite the hinge.

steps.title: Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the RNA pellet for 00:03:00 by placing the tube on its side inside a folded kim wipe; do not overdry.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL of nuclease-free water by pipetting up and down 10 times, letting the water wash down the hinge side of the tube.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Aliquot the sample for quality control and clean the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Place a 5 µL aliquot of the RNA sample into a separate 1.5 mL tube for QC and store on the Eppendorf ThermoMixer at 4 °C.
Store the remaining sample immediately in the -80 °C freezer.
Dispose of all TRI Reagent and chloroform waste in the 'Phenol:Chloroform Waste' amber bottle and any contaminated plasticware in the 'Mutagen/Carcinogen Sharps' bin inside the fume hood.
Return RNA clean pipettes, racks, and consumables to the RNA clean drawer.
Wipe down the chemical fume hood and RNA clean workstation with 75% ethanol.
